projects.title: Daily Reset
projects.summary: A self-reflection Android app with daily quotes, mood tracking, guided journaling, and a streak system.
projects.description: A lifestyle app I designed, built, and published on my own. It helps people build a daily reflection habit, and I own its full lifecycle from design to Play Console release and ongoing updates.
highlights: Google Sign-In with cloud backup, so users can restore their data across devices.
Customizable morning and evening reminders, daily trivia, and favourite-saving.
Premium tier through a one-time in-app purchase (ad-free, unlimited favourites), plus AdMob monetization.
Full product ownership: design, development, store release, privacy policy, and updates.

projects.title: Social Media Content Automation
projects.summary: Generates monthly content ideas and images, then publishes approved posts across channels automatically.
projects.description: An automation tool built at CVtot. It connects to a client's Google Drive, keeps a Google Sheet of AI-suggested content ideas, and turns the approved ones into ready-to-post images published through Buffer.
highlights: Reads and updates a Google Sheet that auto-suggests monthly content concepts.
Generates matching images for each approved idea with AI image generation.
Publishes directly to social channels through the Buffer API.
Clients only review and approve, which cuts manual production time.

projects.title: Hotel Booking System
projects.summary: A booking platform with room search, reservations, and secure payments through Stripe and VNPAY.
projects.description: A full-stack booking platform with a React frontend and a Spring Boot backend. Guests search and filter rooms, reserve, and pay online, with access secured by Spring Security and JWT.
highlights: Room search and filtering with a reservation flow.
Online payments through both Stripe and VNPAY.
Authentication secured with Spring Security and JWT.
Backend tuned for faster API responses.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.summary: An online store with product management, order processing, and payments, deployed on AWS.
projects.description: A secure, scalable store built with Spring Boot and a server-rendered Thymeleaf UI. It is deployed on AWS for high availability, with database queries optimized for faster load times.
highlights: Product management, order processing, and payments.
Secured with Spring Security and JWT.
Deployed on AWS using Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, and S3.
